question: Which female athlete became the second woman in history to win the Laureus World Sportswoman of the Year four times by April 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Simone Biles**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Simone Biles**, the legendary **American gymnast**, became the second woman in history to secure the **Laureus World Sportswoman of the Year** title four times by the **April 2025** award cycle.
 
• She previously won this prestigious award in **2017**, **2019**, and **2020**, following her dominant performances in the **Rio Olympics** and various **World Championships**.
 
• Her fourth win follows an extraordinary performance at the **2024 Paris Olympics**, where she won **three gold medals** (Team, All-around, and Vault) and **one silver** (Floor exercise). ***Hence, the correct answer is Simone Biles.***
